parameters.description: Only nodes whose name starts with this, ignoring case.

parameters.name: q

parameters.description: The cursor of the previous page.

AgentPacing.description: The stored pacing of this cell's agents (ADR 0013).

heartbeat_seconds.description: Mean time between two heartbeats of an idle agent.

jitter_percent.description: Spreads each interval evenly around heartbeat_seconds.

reconnect_base_seconds.description: Ceiling of the full-jitter delay after the first failed cycle.

reconnect_max_seconds.description: Largest ceiling of the full-jitter delay; not below reconnect_base_seconds.

online_window_seconds.description: What one and a half of the longest interval, heartbeat_seconds plus its jitter, must fit in. Set by nodes.online_seconds less the liveness flush interval.

AgentShed.description: How much agent traffic this cell refuses (ADR 0043).

level.description: What control refuses from agents: nothing, bulk calls, bulk and telemetry, or everything but quarantine reports.

observed_at.description: Agent observation year 2020 through 2200; never used for server connectivity or lease clocks.

connectivity_changed_at.description: When control last recorded a change of connectivity. History only: connectivity is derived from last_heartbeat_at and may be ahead of it. Null on MySQL and Dameng.

last_heartbeat_at.description: Last authenticated heartbeat or current task lease renewal, written in batches and so up to the configured flush interval behind them; metric/fact observation timestamps remain independent.

NodeCounts.description: How many nodes are in each state. Removed nodes do not count; a disabled node counts under its connectivity as well.
